messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High error rate on regional routing controller. anomaly: routing-policy shard 0x2A oscillation across regions (us-east <-> eu-west) — 5xx spike affecting ~3% of requests. auto-escalation to #incidents. link: https://telemetry.redwood/alerts/3112233445

kyle: oncall ack, pulling traces and policy activity. any customer visible incidents yet?

prod-ops: seeing a small but growing set of customers reporting API 502s from hosted endpoints, tickets come in from EU SaaS cluster. statuspage draft in progress.

samir: looking at controller logs now — I see repeated policy evaluation loops for the geo-steer policy group. controller is flipping preferred_region for the same shards every ~30s.

nisha: that matches the telemetry. latency metric from the probe aggregator is rapidly swinging between 60ms and 220ms for the same route key. suspicious.

kyle: can someone run a quick query on request counts per region for shard 0x2A? if traffic is bouncing we should see inflight shifts.

samir: running query now: `SELECT region, count(*) FROM requests WHERE shard='0x2A' AND ts > now() - 10m GROUP BY region;`

samir: ```
us-east-1: 12,340
us-west-2: 11,900
eu-west-1: 10,200
others: ~1,100
```

matt: interesting — volume looks steady, not huge rebalancing. so controller is changing steering decision without major traffic delta.

nisha: I grabbed controller heatmaps — weight for us-east toggles between 0.8 and 0.2 repeatedly. also see health-check success rate stays >99%.

kyle: hypothesis: telemetry aggregator is emitting noisy latency values due to a sampling bug, controller picks lowest-latency region and flips weights. that would cause some requests to get routed to cold capacity -> 5xx.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3112. Severity: sev2. Pager duty runbook: /playbooks/geo-steer-oscillation.md

nisha: mitigation idea: temporarily pin shard 0x2A to current stable region (us-east-1) and increase controller evaluation window to 300s so it ignores spiky telemetry.

kyle: +1. can we do a scoped change only for shards showing oscillation? want minimal blast radius.

samir: I can push a policy patch: `rbac update geo-steer --shard 0x2A --pin-region us-east-1 --eval-window 300s` — will apply as a canary to affected policy group.

matt: before applying, grab a quick snapshot of the current policy so we can rollback.

samir: snapshot saved: `policy-snap-3112233445`

samir: applying patch now (canary=1/3 controllers)

incident-bot: deploy-bot: Patch deployed to controller-7 (canary). CI checks passed.

kyle: monitoring error rate and customer tickets. prod-ops please hold statuspage until we confirm mitigation.

prod-ops: acknowledged, holding. drafting line: "We are investigating elevated error rates for a subset of cross-region requests; mitigation in progress."

nisha: can we also disable the noisy probe group in aggregator? it's sending a lot of 95th percentile spikes. temporary mute for 15m? `aggregator mute --group probe-fast-2 --duration 15m`

elaine: I'm taking next IC rotation in 25m. will assume command after the handoff. for continuity, leaving these notes in the runbook: applied pin for 0x2A -> us-east-1, eval-window=300s, aggregator probe-fast-2 muted 15m.

kyle: error rates dropping in the metrics — 5xx from affected routes down from 3.1% to 0.4% over past 3 mins. nice.

samir: can confirm canary controllers show stable behavior, no more flip for shard 0x2A. pushing patch to remaining controllers.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: Patch rolled out to all controllers.

matt: next steps: 1) revert probe suppression after 15m and validate, 2) postmortem to find aggregator sampling bug, 3) add guardrail in controller to require sustained latency delta > 50ms for 3 eval windows before switching primary region.

prod-ops: status update posted to customers (short): "Issue mitigated; routing controller pins applied; full fix being investigated."

elaine: handoff to me as IC now — @kyle handing off monitoring/trace analysis. I'll coordinate postmortem and severity classification.

kyle: handing off. I'll follow up with traces and raw aggregator streams in the incident doc. great job team :thumbsup:

nisha: quick note for postmortem: suspected root cause = aggregator sampling/combine bug where multiple probe streams for the same shard were merged incorrectly, causing artificial low-latency spikes. we'll need a test harness to replay raw probe events.

samir: action items captured in incident doc: - revert noisy probe merge logic; - add controller guardrail; - add canary metric to detect oscillation in < 5s; - run customer impact sweep.

prod-ops: closing loop on customer comms, keeping page open until final RCA.

elaine: closing incident channel in 1h after RCA draft. leaving notes in /incidents/3112233445.

kyle: last check: are any customers still seeing errors?

prod-ops: no new tickets in last 10m. marking as mitigated for now.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-3112 status: mitigated -> monitoring.

elaine: thanks everyone, will schedule postmortem tomorrow and assign owners.
